meta.title: Top 10 Things to Do in Hoi An at Night Vietnam March 2025 Travel Guide Lanterns Markets & Boat Ride
meta.description:
#hoian #vietnam #nightmarket #lanternfestival
Discover the top 10 must-do activities in Hoi An Ancient Town after dark! From glowing lanterns and river boat rides to vibrant night markets and delicious street food, experience the magic of this UNESCO World Heritage Site in Vietnam when the sun goes down. Don’t miss these unforgettable nighttime highlights!
